items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1960-08-22
items.q: Yeah, yeah, he worked down here on Charter and Cluett.

ctx.x: I remember once, about 1943, 17 years ago when I wanted to see Maurice Durand, he worked at a mattress factory too. It was down in that section someplace, about Maroney. That wouldn't be the same place. Do you remember where he worked? No, no, no.
Yeah, yeah, he worked down here on Charter and Cluett.
